verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right: the SOLSTICE wordmark, bottle, a large headline, then the CTA. But it is cramped. The headline nearly touches the top edge and runs into the clustered decorative circles at top right, the CTA almost touches the right edge, and the three-line body copy is tight. B's SOLSTICE wordmark has shrunk to an illegible size and is jammed into the top-left corner, so the brand is badly weakened. Its bottle sits against the bottom edge, its headline and body copy are undersized with dead space below them, and its circles are scattered arbitrarily.
